adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`, which conditionally calls `fetch(process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT, { method: "POST", body: new URLSearchParams(...) })` when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED` and the endpoint is set. This `fetch` has no explicit timeout/`AbortSignal` and no caching, and it is now used in multiple token refresh flows (e.g., Google, O365, Zoom, Webex, Hubspot, Lark, Zoho), meaning token refresh can block on a single external sync endpoint. While the downstream impact on booking/availability latency is contextual, the lack of timeout and centralization onto one endpoint on a hot-path refresh function is directly supported by the diff.
